tei:div.tei:p: "$ (497)༄༅// thugs rje chen po dang bde mgon sbrags sgrub nag po gzi mdangs kyi sgrub pa zhes bya ba dpal chen rgwa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud bzhugs so//

(498)༄༅// na mo lo ke shwa ra tsa kra sam+bhar ma hā kā lā ya// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'dud// bka' yi gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlobs// bsil ba tshal du dpal chen rgwa lo la// snyan brgyud skor rnams mgon po nyid kyis gnang*// bod du slob ma bla ma spyan la gnang*// de nas brgyud de phar 'phel tshur 'phel gyur// gsang ba'i gsang sgrub yin par spyan gyis bzhed// nag po gzi mdangs sgrub pa phag grus gnang*// gsal stong sgom pas nag po'i srog sgrub zer// mgon po bka' babs lto pa char 'bebs kyis// gsang sgrub bla na med pa yin par gsungs// nag po'i srog la nag po sba pa zhes// bla ma zhang gi bzhed pa yin par 'dug /blo snying brang gsum gtad pa'i slob ma ni// ma gtogs gzhan la mi ston bka' rgyas btab// nag pos nag po gzi mdangs skyed dang gcig /nag pos nag po dbang du sdud dang gnyis// dbang du 'dus nas dngos grub blang dang gsum// 'khor lo gcig tu dril ba'i gdams pa yin// yid kyis bsgom zhing sngags bzlas chog pa ste// mngon rtogs ngag tu brjod pa ma yin no// sems can thams cad (499)'khor lo bde mchog gi /go 'phang thob phyir bdag gis 'di nyid bsgom// rang nyid skad cig bde mchog lhan skyes ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol// phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pad nyi 'jigs dus mnan// rang 'od me phung 'khrugs pa'i dbus na 'gyings// gar gyi nyams dgu dpal gyi chas bcu rdzogs// sku yi nang ni phru ma phus btab bzhin// lte 'og gsum mdor chos 'byung dmar po ni// yangs shing rgya che'i nang du pad nyi'i steng*// dpal ldan ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa// phyag g.yas dang po gri snying nor bu'i dbyibs// g.yas 'og ral gri g.yon pas thod pa dang*// g.yon 'og kha ṭ+wāṃ zhabs gnyis btsan skyil bzhugs// phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud// mgon po'i dbu gtsug pad+ma zla ba'i gdan// rgyal ba rgya mtsho cha lugs spyi ltar la// dang po'i phyag gnyis bar du nor bu bsnams// thugs kar zla steng hrīḥl yig drug 'khor// mgon po'i thugs kar las mgon bya rog gdong*// gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pa'i thugs ka ru// nyi steng hūm̐ mthar bde mchog yig bdun dang*// (500)de rgyab mgon po'i rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor// mgon po phag mo'i sbyor mtshams gsang gnas su// kā li nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma// gri gug ral gri thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskums bzhugs pa'i bha ga'i nang*// chos 'byung sngon po'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag

/ye shes mgon po'i thugs srog ngo bor bsgom// mgon po'i gdan gyi chos 'byung zur gsum por// tshe bdag 'chi bdag srog bdag bya rog gdong*// gri gug thod khrag 'dzin cing bya gshog can// yum ni sha za rkang ldag rtsa 'jib ma// dmar mo lcags kyu thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud// gtso 'khor thams cad dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs// so so'i thugs srog sngags las 'od zer ni// dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag med 'phros// bsil ba tshal sogs dur khrod brgyad rnams nas// bya rog gdong can la sogs nag po stong*// seng ge'i gdong can la sogs sha za 'bum// kā li nag mo ma mo bye ba'i tshogs// lta srin sde brgyad lha mi thams cad kyi// byang sems dkar dmar bkrag dang gzi mdangs kun// bsdus nas ye shes mgon po'i thugs kar thim// ye shes mgon po bkrag dang gzi mdangs rgyas// mgon po yab yum sku lus bde bas gang*// sbyor mtshams byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun chen 'bebs// bdag nyid bde mchog sku lus mer gyis gang*// sku gsung thugs gyi bcud dang dngos grub rnams// bdag gi gnas lngar thim pas bkrag mdangs rgyas// spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag gi nor bu las// 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros// sems can kun gyi bcud dang bsod nams kun// bsdus nas bdag gi lus gang dngos grub thob// de ltar bsgom zhing gtso bor yig drug bzla// thun mjug bde mchog (501)yig bdun cung zad dang*// mgon po'i bsnyen pa brgya re byas pas 'thus// oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa// oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rmi lam bla ma mgon po mi chen sogs// rang la mi gus phar la phyag 'tshal sogs// byung na chos skyong dbang du ma 'dus rtags// yin phyir gsang gnas kā li nag mo yi// chos 'byung hūm̐ la sngags kyis g.yon du bskor// de las 'od zer dmar nag phyogs bcur 'phros// mgon po 'khor bcas mdun du spyan drangs bzhugs// khong rnams sa bon srog snying sngags dang bcas// 'od zer gyis drangs yum gyi bha ga yi// sa bon la ni thim par gyur ma thag

/mgon po 'khor bcas bdag gi dbang du 'dus// 'dar dang phril phril cig gsung bka' nyan bsam// de yis mgon po 'khor bcas dbang du 'dus// nag po gzi mdangs sgrub pa ngo mtshar can// sku rigs ma yi glegs bam kun gyi bcud// gsang sgrub 'khor lo lnga ma gnyis ma sogs// mgon po'i khrid rim kun gyi yang snying ste// drung chen mkha' spyod pa nas brgyud pa'i phyir// dbus su mgon po khams byon ma ru grags// thugs rje chen po bde mgon sbrags sgrub 'di// rang gi rgyun khyer nyams su blangs pa bzhin// slob bu pad+ma thabs mkhas nyid la gdams// snyan brgyud sba 'os gsal bkod nyes pa rnams// ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas la bshags// dge bas sgrub brgyud bstan pa mtha' rgyas shog /de skad shugs 'chang me pho rta yi lo// tha skar zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin// ston pa lha las lhags pa'i dus mchod kyi// thun mtshams skabs su rā ga a s+yas smras// dge bshes pad+ma thabs mkhas zhes byas bris// maṅga lam/ (502)
